Plot: 24 ft × 50 ft (1200 sqft built area), facing North.
Location: Pune, Maharashtra.
2BHK floor plan: ground floor + first floor (G+1).
Ground floor: living (12×14 ft), dining (10×10 ft), kitchen (10×8 ft), powder room.
First floor: master bedroom (12×12 ft) with attached bath, second bedroom (10×12 ft), common bath, balcony.
Stairs in center. Vastu-compliant: kitchen SE, master bedroom SW, pooja room NE.
Structural: RCC frame, isolated footings.
Budget: Rs. 35 lakh.
